reports.title: Sotera Health Reports Solid Third-Quarter and Year-to-Date 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Outlook
section: •Net revenues in the range of $1.233 billion to $1.250 billion, representing constant currency growth of 5.25% to 6.75%.
•Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $632 million to $641 million, representing constant currency growth of 5.75% to 7.25%.
•Full-year Adjusted EBITDA margins approximately flat versus 2025.
•The foreign currency benefit to net revenues and Adjusted EBITDA has been revised to 70 basis points from 100 basis points in our previous outlook.
•Interest expense narrowed to a range of $137 million to $140 million.
•Tax rate applicable to Adjusted Net Income(2) remains in the range of 27.0% to 28.0%.
•Adjusted EPS range remains in the range of $0.95 to $1.01.
•A weighted-average fully diluted share count remains in the range of 289 million to 291 million shares.
•Capital expenditures remain in the range of $200 million to $225 million.
